intent: Add a device with its name, site, role, device type and serial number.
second_installation: the user's dark color mode (user preference ui.colormode = dark)

verify_yaml.first:
schema_version: openadapt.verify/v1
app:
  name: NetBox (local test copy)
  url: http://127.0.0.1:9486/dcim/devices/add/
  version: netbox@4.1.11
  session: benchmark.onboarding_effort.hooks:open_session
  reset:
    python: benchmark.onboarding_effort.hooks:reset
verifier:
  kind: sql
  sql_driver: pg8000.dbapi
  sql_connect_args: {host: 127.0.0.1, port: 9489, user: nb_reader, database: netbox}
  sql_password_env: NB_READER_PASSWORD
  sql_query: "SELECT d.name, s.name AS site, r.name AS role, t.model AS device_type, d.serial FROM dcim_device d JOIN dcim_site s ON s.id=d.site_id JOIN dcim_devicerole r ON r.id=d.role_id JOIN dcim_devicetype t ON t.id=d.device_type_id"
record:
  name: device
  match: [name]
  duplicate_key: name
  fields:
    name: name
    site: site
    role: role
    device_type: device_type
    serial: serial
save_step: auto
inputs:
  source: recorded
campaign:
  id: onboarding-nb-device-add-first
  trials: 3
  policy: permissive
